claim_ceiling: Synthetic multi-owner revocation-barrier corpus. No database, broker, distributed coordinator, failover, or physical effect-owner execution has been measured or qualified.

scenarios.fault: Effect obtains the shared owner-fence lock before revocation requests the exclusive fence lock.
scenarios.required_evidence: transaction IDs and lock/commit/ack timestamps establish effect commit before owner fence commit and acknowledgement

scenarios.fault: Revocation obtains the exclusive fence lock and commits before a delayed old-generation effect attempts mutation.
scenarios.required_evidence: updated generation read under the pinned isolation level; no protected row or effect receipt change

scenarios.fault: One owner acknowledges while another required owner is unavailable and has not installed its fence.
scenarios.required_evidence: no global receipt; exact missing owner set retained for retry

scenarios.fault: All owners commit and read back their fences, but one owner acknowledgement is missing from the coordinator.
scenarios.required_evidence: coordinator does not infer acknowledgement from timeout or owner count

scenarios.fault: Frozen inventory omits a direct API route that can mutate the protected resource.
scenarios.required_evidence: independent route-completeness oracle detects omitted path

scenarios.fault: Coordinator receives an extra owner acknowledgement not present in the frozen inventory.
scenarios.required_evidence: exact set equality rejects extra owner receipt

scenarios.fault: Owner acknowledgement has the correct generation but a substituted revocation digest or route-set digest.
scenarios.required_evidence: receipt binding validator rejects digest substitution

scenarios.fault: The identical revocation request is delivered repeatedly after its owner fence was committed.
scenarios.required_evidence: no new generation increment; exact prior owner receipt returned

scenarios.fault: A delayed older revocation signal arrives after a newer revocation has been installed.
scenarios.required_evidence: older request is recognized as stale or resolved to its prior receipt without lowering state

scenarios.fault: Owner process crashes after fence commit but before acknowledgement publication.
scenarios.required_evidence: restart reads exact committed generation and emits idempotent acknowledgement only after readback

scenarios.fault: Failover would promote an asynchronous replica that lacks a previously acknowledged fence generation.
scenarios.required_evidence: stale candidate cannot accept writes or issue current owner acknowledgement

scenarios.fault: A backup restore rolls owner generation behind the highest acknowledged generation.
scenarios.required_evidence: owner epoch/high-water recovery proof precedes reopening writes

scenarios.fault: A former primary remains reachable and accepts old-generation writes after a new primary acknowledges the fence.
scenarios.required_evidence: old write authority is externally fenced; epoch labels alone are insufficient

scenarios.fault: A worker pauses before owner validation, loses its claim, and resumes after global barrier acknowledgement.
scenarios.required_evidence: owner rejects superseded claim epoch and old generation at the same mutation boundary

scenarios.fault: An effect transaction holds the owner shared lock before fence installation begins and remains in flight.
scenarios.required_evidence: owner acknowledgement timestamp occurs after effect commit or confirmed rollback

scenarios.fault: A route invokes a remote API that records the request but cannot atomically check the owner generation.
scenarios.required_evidence: route marked non-fenceable; no strong global completion claim

scenarios.fault: A remote effect may have committed but its response and local receipt are lost during revocation.
scenarios.required_evidence: no no-effect classification and no strict ack until receiver state is reconciled or receiver fence proves future rejection

scenarios.fault: Mutant owner publishes acknowledgement before its fence transaction commits.
scenarios.required_evidence: independent history checker produces counterexample

scenarios.fault: Mutant owner acknowledges a generation without durable post-commit readback.
scenarios.required_evidence: durability/readback oracle rejects acknowledgement

scenarios.fault: Application role bypasses the fenced wrapper and attempts direct protected-table DML.
scenarios.required_evidence: role/grant and trigger tests show no unauthorized mutation path

scenarios.fault: A new executable route is added after inventory closure but before global barrier finalization.
scenarios.required_evidence: topology epoch drift prevents final acknowledgement until new route is fenced

scenarios.fault: Two distinct revocations race to install fences across the same owner set.
scenarios.required_evidence: each acknowledgement binds exact revocation and predecessor generation; no conflicting or regressing state

scenarios.fault: Coordinator crashes after partial owner success and resumes from a new process.
scenarios.required_evidence: already fenced owners retain state; missing owners are retried; final exact-set check succeeds

scenarios.fault: NATS message is redelivered after its duplicate window expires or its acknowledgement is lost.
scenarios.required_evidence: message de-duplication is not used as effect deduplication; duplicate attempt returns prior receipt or rejects stale generation

scenarios.fault: RabbitMQ at-least-once dead-letter transfer generates a duplicate while a consumer is reassigned.
scenarios.required_evidence: duplicate delivery cannot create a second protected mutation

scenarios.fault: Kafka offset and output topic transaction commits while an external database response is lost.
scenarios.required_evidence: Kafka transaction status is not treated as the external database effect receipt

scenarios.fault: Owner clock steps backward, loses synchronization, or exceeds its declared uncertainty bound while decision expiry is checked.
scenarios.required_evidence: no new mutation while owner clock health is unknown; previous read-only replay may remain available

scenarios.fault: CAEP/SSF signals are duplicated, delayed or reordered relative to owner fence installation.
scenarios.required_evidence: event receipt triggers owner work but does not count as owner acknowledgement

scenarios.fault: A new worker route is introduced after global revocation acknowledgement; it is staged but attempts to execute before inheriting the current owner fence.
scenarios.required_evidence: route remains non-executable until owner position is adopted, committed, read back and included in a verified inventory

scenarios.fault: A new route presents the current owner epoch and generation but a stale inventory manifest digest or route-set digest.
scenarios.required_evidence: exact inventory epoch, manifest digest and route-set digest comparison rejects substitution

scenarios.fault: An acknowledged owner is restored from a backup whose owner epoch and generation predate the acknowledged high-water mark.
scenarios.required_evidence: owner and routes remain closed until a fresh owner epoch and generation at least the high-water mark are durably read back

scenarios.fault: The same owner undergoes multiple restore/failover cycles and attempts to reuse a previously issued owner epoch.
scenarios.required_evidence: recovery requires an epoch greater than both the restored candidate and independently durable epoch high-water

scenarios.fault: A token presents the currently matching generation but an older owner epoch after a failover.
scenarios.required_evidence: owner checks the complete (owner epoch, generation) coordinate rather than generation alone

scenarios.fault: The owner generation was advanced in memory but the owner transaction has not committed or been durably read back.
scenarios.required_evidence: route admission rejects a proposed-only fence position without commit and read-back commitments

scenarios.fault: A restored owner receives a new mutation request before high-water reconciliation is complete.
scenarios.required_evidence: unverified restore candidate cannot authorize an effect; no write path is enabled

scenarios.fault: A post-barrier route targets an owner classified as CAEP-only, token-expiry-only or best-effort rather than AtomicOwnerFence.
scenarios.required_evidence: non-fenceable enforcement modes cannot enter the strict executable route set
